## Installing StrataField

1. Download **StrataField_…_x64-setup.exe** below (under *Assets*).
2. Double-click it.
3. If Windows shows **"Windows protected your PC"**, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Windows shows this for new programs that are not yet signed.
4. Follow the installer. No administrator password is needed; StrataField is installed just for you.
5. Open **StrataField** from the Start menu. **Getting started with StrataField**, a short guide you can print, is there too.

Works on Windows 10 and 11. If this computer had the older StrataField, your borewells are brought over automatically the first time it opens; the old file is not changed.

**Already have StrataField?** It offers this update by itself: choose **Install and restart** when asked, or go to **Settings & backup → About → Check for updates**. (Copies from version 1.0.0 need this installer once; after that, updates are automatic.) Your data is kept.

**Uninstalling** removes the app but keeps your data in `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

More help: [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/Mehulsri07/StrataField/blob/main/INSTALL.md) · Security: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Mehulsri07/StrataField/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

<sub>The `.sig` file and `latest.json` are used by the app's automatic updates; you don't need to download them.</sub>
